notes.title: Bug Fixes and Reworks
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579570/5cc5b55daa687858322ed39687dfc86ab7f22aa1.png[/img]

Teleport Indicators are added.

Made teleport less terrible. It is now perfectly on beat. Before it was just offsetting the time by a beat length. So if the player was off beat the teleport would be off beat. Also removed the disabling inputs from it so you can do an action after teleporting. makes staying on beat feel way better

Fixed player desynced from grid on tilt bug.

Previous patch/update it's already in but there was a bug that was fixed in the update before where if you complete it on a certain game mode you don't get the achievement, sorry about that! IT IS FIXED you should get the achievement if you beat the game on whatever game mode you choose.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579570/5cc5b55daa687858322ed39687dfc86ab7f22aa1.png[/img]


Dj CyberByte Bug Fixes: 
Staying Green when controls are inverted has been fixed.
Tail Drum in Phase Too now actually has the tail rise instead of no where to be scene, so the player actually has some indication the attack is about to occur.

Updated Treasure Room so you can actually see echo with a some delay before going to the end screen.

In the loss Menu the first button highlighted is now restart.

notes.title: Release Date Update – Now Launching May 15!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We have a quick update regarding the release of Echo Rift.

We've decided to take a few extra days to polish our game and make sure our players have the best experience possible. As our team works on the game's finishing touches, [b]our new release date is planned for May 15th[/b].

Thank you so much for your understanding. We can't wait to share Echo Rift with you very soon!

Stay tuned,
— The Echo Rift Team
